top_findings.title: 2 of 9 tests fail on a clean checkout — test fixture's DB isolation is dead code
top_findings.evidence: test_app.py:17-22 creates a tempfile DB and sets app.config['DATABASE'], but app.py:6 uses a module-level DATABASE='books.db' that nothing ever reads; all 9 tests share one on-disk books.db and rows accumulate. Fresh copy in scratch: 'FAILED test_app.py::test_get_books - assert 2 == 1' and 'FAILED test_app.py::test_get_books_by_author - assert 4 == 2'; '2 failed, 7 passed in 0.06s'. Stored scores.json test_coverage=0.91 is a coverage percentage, not a pass rate, so it does not surface this.
top_findings.suggestion: Read the DB path from app.config (e.g. app.config.setdefault('DATABASE','books.db') and get_db_connection() using current_app.config['DATABASE']), so the fixture's tempfile override actually takes effect and each test gets an empty database.

note: Second-opinion pass. requirement_coverage re-scored 0.9167 -> 1.0: the prior pass marked R9 partial for accepting empty-string title/author, but R9's pinned criterion is 'Creating without title/author is rejected (400)', which app.py:44-45 satisfies (probed: 400 for both missing cases). That weakness is retained as low finding val-1. The prior pass's confirmed finding — 2 of 9 tests fail on a clean checkout — is kept at high severity. min_severity=high. tracker=beads requested, but this skill is v2.0 and creates no beads/GitHub records; it only aggregates into assessment.json.
